field.name: Hubble Ultra Deep Field
field.catalogue: JADES, the JWST Advanced Deep Extragalactic Survey (Rieke and others 2023, ApJS 269, 16; VizieR V/159: gssample, gskron, gsprism), the GOODS-South galaxies inside the box; stars left out by the MUSE Hubble Ultra Deep Field survey (Bacon and others 2023, A&A 670, A4; VizieR J/A+A/670/A4/dr2-main)
field.source: VizieR V/159 ReadMe ('These HLSP data products are licensed for use under CC BY 4.0', read 2026-10-20); Rafelski and others 2015, AJ 150, 31 (the footprint: RA 53.117 to 53.208, Dec -27.831 to -27.752, VizieR J/AJ/150/31, read 2026-10-20); Bacon and others 2023, A&A 670, A4 (VizieR, read 2026-10-20)

cosmology: Planck 2018 as data/cosmology.js (Astropy's Planck18): comoving distance now

rules.distance: the comoving distance of the redshift: NIRSpec's (flag A or B) where there is one, else JADES's photometric estimate
rules.size: the half-light radius in F090W as an angle, times the comoving distance: as wide from the Sun as Webb saw it
rules.brightness: F200W Kron, as the absolute magnitude that looks that bright from the Sun at that distance: an exposure, not photometry
rules.colour: F090W - F444W as observed, mapped onto a blue-to-red tint: illustrative

licence: JADES (VizieR V/159): CC BY 4.0. MUSE (VizieR J/A+A/670/A4): free for scientific usage, the authors cited
